purpose: Merge-only Spring cleaner progression with the current Invention recipe, upgrade thresholds and self-sufficient tight-spring component bottleneck. Live spring prices and profitability are excluded.

equipment_additions.name: Spring cleaner progression

upgrade_ladder.unlock: Automatically high-alchemises configured salvage drops at the cost of one spring per salvage.
Automatically disassembles configured salvage drops without consuming a spring; free disassembly does not advance upgrades.
Further improves the cleaner's older dismantle/research functionality.
Higher-tier cleaner with the full pre-9001 salvage configuration set.
Extends supported automatic cleaning to noted salvage drops.

equipment_additions.supply_bottleneck: A self-sufficient account can craft tight springs, but the tensile-part and subtle-component cost is the meaningful long-run constraint. Store the component recipe and upgrade ladder rather than a volatile spring coin price.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: The 43 Invention unlock is only the first gate. Track the 600-spring free-disassembly milestone and 10,000-spring noted-salvage milestone separately, and let regional component-supply rows determine how practical those milestones are.
